title: The Cesti (fragments of book 7)
edition: PG 10; Cesti fragmenta (Khazarzar extract of book 7)
author: Julius Africanus
blurb: Julius Africanus, Cesti (Embroidered Girdles). Tip of book 7 through military hunting (1.1–1.14): table of contents, proem, On arming, destruction of enemies, athletic contest, wound-cutting, iron wound, horse chapters, pack-animals, kicking mule, and hunting. New English from locked PG 10 Greek. River and wall measure, theft of sound, staying awake, elephants, farming paradoxes, and the missile seal are not in this volume. No previous English of the Cesti body is known; ANF translates the letters only.
era_note: Sextus Julius Africanus, Christian chronographer and encyclopedist, early third century. This page is a tip of book 7, not the whole Cesti.
first_english_note: No complete English of the Cesti body is known. ANF (Roberts) translates Africanus's letters, not this encyclopedic fragment. This is a new rendering from locked PG 10 Greek.

text_history.method: New English from locked PG 10 / Khazarzar Greek of Cesti book 7 through 7.14 (military hunting). Earlier lemma-led scaffold English was discarded. Remainder of book 7 held.
